question: When a Run waits in its item's lane behind another, does the jobs API's `started_at` for its job say when the job left the queue and began, later than the run's `run_started_at` by the time it waited, and what does a read of its job give while it waits?
pass: Written before the run (issue 633; section 6): two pushes ten seconds apart to a canary branch start two runs of one workflow whose one job, granted nothing, sleeps sixty seconds under concurrency {group: lane-p64, cancel-in-progress: false}, so that the second waits behind the first. Every ten seconds until both have concluded, the runs are read (GET actions/workflows/trial-p64.yml/runs) and so are each run's jobs (GET actions/runs/{run_id}/jobs). Pass if, for the second run, all three hold: (1) its job's started_at, at the first read that gives the job in_progress or completed, is no earlier than five seconds before the first run's job's completed_at; (2) that started_at is later than the second run's run_started_at by at least thirty seconds, and run_started_at is the same at every read; (3) the job's started_at is the same at every read from that one on. What the reads give while the second run waits, whether its job is listed and with what status, created_at and started_at, is recorded beside the verdict and is not part of the pass. The Factory's Run is a dispatch, not a push; a concurrency group applies to a job whatever started its workflow, and the fixture notes the trigger as a difference.

body.principle: The verdict follows the pass condition written before the run, from issue 633 and section 6.
body.workflow:
# Trial P-64 (software-factory, issue 633): one job under a concurrency group, on one branch only. It is granted
# nothing, holds no secret, checks nothing out and caches nothing; it sleeps, so that a second run waits behind it.
name: trial-p64
on:
  push:
    branches: [trial/p-64]
    paths: ["p64/**"]
permissions: {}
jobs:
  lane:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    concurrency:
      group: lane-p64
      cancel-in-progress: false
    steps:
      - run: sleep 60
